semantics.clock: All sequential updates occur on the positive edge, as explicitly specified.
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous reset: each rising edge with reset high restarts the four-cycle enable interval.
semantics.cycles: Immediately after a reset rising edge shift_ena is high; it remains high after the next three non-reset rising edges, then becomes low at the fourth non-reset rising edge and stays low until another sampled reset.
semantics.initialization: The original problem specifies no power-up state; behavior before the first sampled reset is unconstrained. No initial block is introduced.

verification.oracle: Independent elapsed-cycle model grounded in the original four-cycle requirement, checking after NBA updates.
directed_cases: reset between edges has no effect
verification.failure_behavior: $fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities: Power-up behavior before reset is unspecified and is not tested as a defined output.
Four cycles are interpreted as four full clock intervals starting immediately after the sampled reset edge. Holding reset high restarts the interval at each sampled edge.
The introductory bit-pattern detection context supplies no detector input; only reset starts the requested interval.
